v9_result_being_followed: V9 failed the broad temporal-lifetime hypothesis: aligned timing did not reliably improve gross access AUC. However, aligned timing did improve probability-leverage AUC and realized causal flips relative to shuffled and shifted replay.
v10_design: Keep the exact donor-derived aligned/shuffled/shifted replay control from v9, but make normalized causal productivity the primary outcome: leverage per frontier contact, realized flips per frontier contact, and realized flips per applied transmission.
scientific_boundary: Causal efficiency only. No claim of memory, learning, adaptation, self-maintenance, homeostasis, autopoiesis, or life.
next_question: If temporal causal efficiency is supported, introduce a second experience and test whether the material dynamics can alter which timing pattern is expressed, before using memory or adaptation terminology.
